notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with browser UA) worked fully - site is server-side rendered (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Demandware), no Playwright/CDP needed. robots.txt (https://www.coin.it/robots.txt) has generic Disallow: /cart,/login,/account only - no Claude/anthropic bot block, tier (a) fully permitted. IMPORTANT SITE NOTE: https://www.coincasa.it/ now 301-redirects (via Cloudflare) to https://www.coin.it/it-it/ - the Coincasa home-goods brand has been folded into the Coin department-store site as its 'Coin Casa' / home section (title tag literally reads 'Coin - Coincasa | Arredo Casa Shop Online'). All research was done on this live redirect target since that is the company's current real site. TREE METHOD: fetched homepage + /it-it/casa/ landing page (full server-rendered mega-menu, union of all /shop-casa/* links), then fetched every candidate leaf category page individually, confirming each via tag and <link rel=canonical> matching the requested slug. Site exposes TWO parallel navigation paths - a room-based tree (bagno/camera-da-letto/soggiorno/tavola-e-cucina/outdoor/mobili/cura-organizzazione-decorazione-casa) and a cross-cutting 'Tessili Casa' (Home Textiles) hub - both are first-class top-nav entries with mostly non-identical product sets (verified via data-pid overlap on suspicious close-count pairs), so both were kept as separate rows per the duplicate rule (different URL + different product IDs = different listing). EXCEPTION: soggiorno/tende-soggiorno was dropped as an exact duplicate of tessili-casa/tende - both pages returned the identical 7 data-pid values, so only tessili-casa/tende was kept. QTY METHOD: exact number scraped from the rendered '<span class=product-count>N Prodotti</span>' header on each category listing page - never estimated. EXCLUDED and why: aria-di-bianco/festa-d'estate/editoriali (seasonal promo/collection pages, not standing categories); illuminazione-interni and all of mobili/* (Lighting and Furniture, explicitly out of scope, site places them under Mobili/Illuminazione top nav); outdoor/giardinaggio (garden furniture/planters, 0 products returned, not textile/storage anyway), outdoor/lanterne-e-vasi-da-esterno and outdoor/mobili-da-giardino (garden decor/furniture, not textile/storage); outdoor/teli-mare-e-accessori (beach bags, bucket hats, cover-ups, embroidered pouches - primarily beach/fashion accessories, only incidentally one beach-towel SKU, so excluded as apparel/accessories not home textile); outdoor/picnic-e-tempo-libero (melamine picnic tableware - Kitchen & Dining, not textile/storage); tessili-casa/homewear (checked product images: dresses, pajamas, robes, t-shirts, ponchos - genuine apparel/loungewear, excluded per Textile Apparel boundary); bagno/accessori-bagno (checked images: mixed bag of soap dispensers, towel racks, small bamboo cabinets/shelves alongside a few baskets - primary category label is generic 'bathroom accessories' not storage/organization, majority non-storage fixtures, excluded); bagno/saponi-e-creme (soaps/creams, not textile/storage); tavola-e-cucina/contenitori-e-cestini (checked images: mostly decorative ceramic/glass/porcelain jars 'di design' for salt/sugar/cookies plus a Christmas cookie jar - primarily Kitchen & Dining/decorative kitchenware, not functional storage, excluded); cura-organizzazione-decorazione-casa/candele-e-diffusori, /lanterne-candelieri-e-portacandele, /portafoto-e-cornici, /soprammobili-e-orologi, /vasi-da-interno (candles, frames, ornaments, vases - Decorative Home Accessories, out of scope). Parent grouping rows only emitted where at least one child qualifies (dropped grouping for the mostly-non-storage 'Cura, organizzazione, decorazione casa' node's decorative siblings while keeping cesti-e-organizer and articoli-da-ufficio under it). articoli-da-ufficio marked confidence LOW - it is a mixed office-supplies category (desk pads, pen holders, phone holders alongside genuine organizers/binders); kept because the category's own title is 'Articoli e organizer da ufficio' and Storage rules explicitly include Office/File Organizers and Document Boxes.
